cases.translation: God, endow the king with Your justice.
cases.explain: The transitive verb 'надари' (endow) takes the accusative case for its direct object.
The transitive verb 'судит' (judges) takes the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: От ___ Евфрата до краев земли будет владеть.
cases.translation: From the River to the ends of the earth he will rule.
cases.explain: The preposition 'от' (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: Those who dwell in the wilderness will bow before the king.
cases.explain: The preposition 'перед' (before) governs the instrumental case.

cases.translation: The kings will bring him gifts and presents.
cases.explain: The transitive verb 'принесут' (will bring) takes the accusative case.
The genitive case is used with 'все' (all) to express the set being referred to.

cases.translation: He will save the poor from oppression.
cases.explain: The preposition 'от' (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: Let all the earth be filled with His glory.
cases.explain: After the verb 'наполнится' (will be filled), the subject nominative 'вся земля' is in nominative case.

reading.ru: Боже, справедливостью Твоей надери царя, и праведностью Твоей сына царского.
reading.question: What does God endow the king and the royal son with?
reading.explain: The verse says God endows them 'справедливостью Твоей' (with Your justice) and 'праведностью Твоей' (with Your righteousness).

reading.ru: Горы принесут процветание народу, и холмы — плоды праведности.
reading.question: What will the mountains and hills bring?
reading.explain: The verse states 'горы принесут процветание, и холмы плоды праведности' - mountains will bring prosperity and hills the fruits of righteousness.

reading.ru: Он будет владычествовать от моря и до моря, и от реки Евфрата до краев земли.
reading.question: Over what territory will the righteous king rule?
options: From sea to sea and from the River Euphrates to the ends of the earth
From the mountains to the plains
reading.correct: From sea to sea and from the River Euphrates to the ends of the earth
reading.explain: The verse specifies 'от моря и до моря ... и от реки Евфрата до краев земли' - from sea to sea and from the River Euphrates to the ends of the earth.

reading.ru: Цари Таршиша и отдаленных побережий принесут ему дань, цари Шевы и Севы принесят дары.
reading.question: What will the distant kings bring to the righteous king?
reading.explain: The verse says the kings 'принесят ему дань' (will bring him tribute) and 'принесят дары' (will bring gifts).

reading.ru: Он спасет нищего, когда тот взывает, и угнетенного, у которого нет помощника.
reading.question: Who will the king save?
options: The needy when they cry out and the oppressed who have no helper
reading.correct: The needy when they cry out and the oppressed who have no helper
reading.explain: The verse says he will save 'нищего' (the needy) 'когда тот взывает' (when he cries out) and 'угнетенного' (the oppressed) 'у которого нет помощника' (who has no helper).

reading.ru: Пусть всегда превозносится Его величественное имя, и наполнится вся земля Его славою.
reading.question: What should happen to God's glorious name and the earth?
options: It should be exalted always and fill the whole earth with His glory
It should be forgotten and remembered only in temples
It should be hidden from nations
It should be feared by all people
reading.correct: It should be exalted always and fill the whole earth with His glory
reading.explain: The verse says 'пусть всегда превозносится Его величественное имя ... и наполнится вся земля Его славою' - Let His glorious name be exalted always and let the whole earth be filled with His glory.
